verdict.rationale: Convertio has a public developer portal with self-serve API keys, an official CLI and PHP wrapper, API-driven operations such as OCR, and dedicated API pricing, so the product can be driven programmatically through a documented public API. However, probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec and no llms.txt, and the pack shows little of the endpoint reference itself. missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or other agent-oriented docs, evidence of detailed endpoint reference coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
